description: Japji Sahib - Morning Prayer by Guru Nanak Dev Ji

verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau nirvair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaadh
verses.translation_en: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace.
verses.phonetic_key: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau nirvair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaadh

verses.translation_en: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.transliteration: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach
verses.translation_en: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||
verses.phonetic_key: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.transliteration: sochai soch na hovee je sochee lakh vaar
verses.translation_en: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds of thousands of times.
verses.phonetic_key: sochai soch na hovee je sochee lakh vaar

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
verses.transliteration: chupai chup na hovee je laae rehaa liv thaar
verses.translation_en: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.
verses.phonetic_key: chupai chup na hovee je laae rehaa liv thaar

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na outharee je bannaa pureeaa bhaar
verses.translation_en: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.
verses.phonetic_key: bhukhiaa bhukh na outharee je bannaa pureeaa bhaar

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.transliteration: sehas siaanapaa lakh hohi th ik na chalai naal
verses.translation_en: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.
verses.phonetic_key: sehas siaanapaa lakh hohi th ik na chalai naal

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
verses.transliteration: kiv sachiaaraa hoeeai kiv koorrai thuttai paal
verses.translation_en: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of illusion be torn away?
verses.phonetic_key: kiv sachiaaraa hoeeai kiv koorrai thuttai paal

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.transliteration: hukam rajaaee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal
verses.translation_en: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||
verses.phonetic_key: hukam rajaaee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕಮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.transliteration: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kehiaa jaaee
verses.translation_en: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.
verses.phonetic_key: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kehiaa jaaee

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕಮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.transliteration: hukamee hovan jeea hukam milai vaddiaaee
verses.translation_en: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.
verses.phonetic_key: hukamee hovan jeea hukam milai vaddiaaee

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕಮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
verses.transliteration: hukamee outham neech hukam likh dhukh sukh paaeeahi
verses.translation_en: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.
verses.phonetic_key: hukamee outham neech hukam likh dhukh sukh paaeeahi

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
verses.transliteration: eikanaa hukamee bakhasees eik hukamee sadhaa bhavaaeeahi
verses.translation_en: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.
verses.phonetic_key: eikanaa hukamee bakhasees eik hukamee sadhaa bhavaaeeahi

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕಮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.transliteration: hukamai andhar sabh ko baahar hukam na koe
verses.translation_en: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.
verses.phonetic_key: hukamai andhar sabh ko baahar hukam na koe

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕಮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.transliteration: naanak hukamai je bujhai th houmai kehai na koe
verses.translation_en: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||
verses.phonetic_key: naanak hukamai je bujhai th houmai kehai na koe
